channel.title: Integ Life Blog
channel.description: Bilingual field notes about productivity, personal systems, focused work, and AI-assisted execution.

item.title: Turn scattered ideas into an executable system
item.description: A productivity system becomes useful when notes, comments, AI review, and todos stay connected instead of living in separate tools.
item.author: Albert

item.title: A focus timer should remember the work
item.description: Pomodoro sessions are more useful when they are attached to todos and become part of a real progress history.
item.author: Albert

item.title: Your productivity system has to follow the device you are using
item.description: Web, Mac, Android, and Wear OS each support a different capture moment, so the system needs offline-first continuity across them.
item.author: Albert

item.title: Goals need evidence, not slogans
item.description: Long-running goals become manageable when milestones, todos, focus sessions, and AI review form a visible execution trail.
item.author: Albert

item.title: A personal back office for independent work
item.description: Freelancers and self-directed workers need a lightweight way to connect time, money, follow-ups, ideas, and execution history.
item.author: Albert
